samples.answer: Rust is a systems programming language that emphasizes memory safety, concurrency, and performance through its innovative ownership model, which enforces safe memory management at compile time without needing a garbage collector.
Rust is a memory-safe systems programming language whose ownership model guarantees thread and memory safety at compile time without a garbage collector.
Rust is a systems programming language that guarantees memory safety and thread safety at compile time through its ownership model, delivering C-level performance without a garbage collector.
